thread:
rahul: Proposing a staggered unpin of runtime-2.14 for model rwd-q4-mistral in eu-west tonight 23:00 UTC. Canary in us-west passed but eu traffic still has SDK variants. Plan: staged rollout 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~3h with SDK feature-flag gating for older clients. Any blockers?

molly: Do we have the SDK usage matrix for eu-west? Mobile SDK 2.7 is still ~9% of requests there. :eyes:

jen: If SDK < 2.8 can't handle the new kernel path we need a fallback. Can we ship a server-side gate that ignores unpin for clients without header?

rahul: Yes — we'll gate by header X-Runtime-Unpin=1. SDK >=2.8 will send header by default; older SDKs will not. That means older clients keep hitting pinned runtime.

deploybot: /deploy start staged-unpin runtime=2.14 model=rwd-q4-mistral regions=eu-west rollout=5%,20%,100% window=3h note="SDK-gated via X-Runtime-Unpin header"

ops-bot: Scheduling window confirmed: 2026-03-20 23:00 UTC -> 2026-03-21 02:00 UTC.

jen: Post-release SLO checks we must run after each stage:
- p95 latency (token gen)
- error rate (5xx + model-timeouts)
- tokens/sec / throughput
Trigger rollback if p95 increases >20% vs baseline OR error-rate >0.5%.

molly: Rollback quick command for runbook: 
```
/deploy rollback staged-unpin runtime=2.14 model=rwd-q4-mistral region=eu-west
```
This will reapply pin for traffic groups immediately.

rahul: Also note: console toggle "runtime_unpin_force" can flip header-level behavior for traffic routed through our API gateway if we need an emergency block. Ops has the key.

sre-oncall: I'll add the incident runbook section and assign paging to oncall during the window. Contact list: jen, molly, rahul, infra-oncall.

jen: Release notes blurb (for docs/changelog):
- Unpinned runtime-2.14 for rwd-q4-mistral in eu-west with staged rollout and SDK gating. Older SDKs (<=2.7) will continue to be routed to pinned runtime until they upgrade. Monitor latency and error-rate; rollback available.

molly: Adding SDK-side note in the changelog: SDK 2.8+ adds X-Runtime-Unpin header and opt-in toggle for teams. Recommend customers upgrade to avoid being stuck on pinned path.

deploybot: deploy started — stage=5% (traffic groups G0..G3) at 23:00 UTC. Canary checks running.

ops-bot: Canary metrics snapshot: p95=48ms (baseline 46ms), error-rate=0.08%, token/sec delta -0.9%. No immediate red flags.

rahul: Wait 30m, then if stable move to 20%.

jen: Also watch A/B diffs for hallucination/regression on a small eval set tied to rwd-q4-mistral. If model quality drops >3% on our eval, hold and investigate.

molly: Noted — running eval harness (eval-run id=eu-unpin-1744).

ops-bot: 30m canary passed. Advancing to 20% in 5 minutes.

rahul: If anything odd, use these two quick mitigations in order: 1) flip runtime_unpin_force=false at the gateway 2) run rollback command.

jen: I'm online for the whole window. Will watch telemetry and eval diffs.

sre-oncall: Paging config set. I'll escalate if thresholds breached.

molly: I'll publish the short release note to the console and mark the rollout steps. :thumbsup:

deploybot: stage=20% complete. Observability: p95=50ms (baseline 46ms), error-rate=0.12%, eval-delta=+0.4% (within tolerance). Proceeding to final ramp in 60m unless any regressions observed.

rahul: Thanks everyone — follow-up thread will include final status + any postmortem if we had to rollback.

ops-bot: Final planned finish time 02:00 UTC.

molly: I'll add an item to release notes: pointer to rollback command and ops toggle.

jen: One more ask — please add a short note in the release ticket about which customer keys saw the change; helps support triage.

rahul: Will update release ticket with per-customer rollout mapping.

sre-oncall: Standby 0/5 — all quiet so far.

deploybot: staged rollout finished 100% at 01:55 UTC. All post-rollout checks passing.

molly: Closing out release docs and tagging release notes with changelog id: rwd-release-2026-03-20-1744.

jen: Great job — keep an eye on overnight telemetry for the next 12h.

rahul: Thanks team. If anything pops, re-open thread or ping page. :handshake:
